Digital Logic uFCoder SDK binary
===============================
Version: 6.0.82 (header last edited 2026-10-19)
Platform: macOS ARM64
Minimum macOS version recorded in binary: 14.0

Files copied unchanged from the user-provided reference:
  ufr_doorcode_xcode/lib-v6.0.82/include/uFCoder.h
  ufr_doorcode_xcode/lib-v6.0.82/macos/arm64/libuFCoder-macos.dylib

The application links and embeds this dynamic library. Xcode signs the
embedded copy using the application's build signing identity.
The vendor's non-thread-safe single-reader API is used exclusively on
one serial queue.

Copyright and library licensing remain with Digital Logic/D-Logic.
The supplied SDK README refers to license/uFR_library_license.md,
which was not present in the supplied lib-v6.0.82 directory.
An unchanged copy of the vendor's published license is provided here as
uFR_library_license.md, retrieved from the official SDK repository:
  https://github.com/nfc-rfid-reader-sdk/ufr-lib/blob/master/license/uFR_library_license.md

The license permits incorporation and distribution in an own project
under its conditions. Use is restricted to Digital Logic uFR hardware.
The library and its materials must not be relicensed as open-source.
This public repository does not change the vendor's rights or restrictions.
